\emph{Determine the domain and range of each relation, and state whether
the relation is a function. }
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $f=\left\{ \left(10,1\right),\left(27,-1\right),\left(37,1\right),\left(10,2\right),\left(47,2\right)\right\} $\\
\textbf{No}, it is not a function. The point $10$ is mapped to $2$
and $1$.\\
Domain: $\left\{ 10,27,37,10,47\right\} $\\
Range: $\{1,-1,2\}$\vfill
\item The curve shown in the graph below.\\

\emph{Let $g(x)=-x^{2}+5x+3$.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item Find $g(-2)$.\\
$g(-2)=-(-2)^{2}+5(-2)+3=-4-10+3=-11$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Use the difference quotient, $\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}$ for $h\neq0$,
to complete and simplify the following problem.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $f(x)=x^{2}+1$.\\
$\frac{\left[(x+h)^{2}+1\right]-\left[x^{2}+1\right]}{h}=\frac{x^{2}+2xh+h^{2}+1-x^{2}-1}{h}=\frac{2xh+h^{2}}{h}=2x+h$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
